programme.title: The Curse Of the King Tut
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, the great Child King Tutankhamen ruled. Few know the details of his life no one knows the secrets of his death. But all is about to change. In 1922 Cairo, free-spirited archaeologist Danny Fremont is certain that if found, King Tut's Emerald Tablet would hold the ultimate power to control the world. But unfortunately, the only person who believes Fremont is his ruthless archaeologist nemesis Morgan Sinclair, a member of a secret society who wants the tablet to harness unspeakable evil on the world and will stop at nothing to get it and then extend their world domination. But with the help of a crackerjack team adventurers that includes the doubting egyptologist Dr. Azelia Barakat, Fremont ventures through the Valley of the Kings, toward Tut's tomb, near the portal to the underworld, and getting closer to the truth behind a mystery that will change the world forever or end it.

programme.title: EuroLeague. Crvena Zvezda Meridianbet Belgrade - Panathinaikos Aktor Athens
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. FC Barcelona - Real Madrid
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Vimbldonas. Official Film
programme.desc: Wimbledon is more than just a tennis tournament — it's a summer tradition, a slice of British culture, and one of the most iconic sporting events in the world. Held every year in London, England, usually in late June to early July, it's where the best tennis players on the planet come to battle it out on the famous grass courts of the All England Club. It's actually the oldest tennis tournament in the world, dating back to 1877, and it's still the only Grand Slam played on grass — the fastest and most unpredictable surface. That's part of what makes it so exciting. Matches are intense, fast-paced, and full of surprises. Wimbledon is packed with unique traditions that make it stand out. Players are required to wear all white on court — no exceptions. The crowd enjoys strawberries and cream, and you won't see flashy ads around the court — it's all about the game. And of course, there's the Royal Box, where you might spot celebrities or even members of the British Royal Family watching the action. From rising stars to tennis legends, everyone dreams of lifting the famous Wimbledon trophy. There's something magical about seeing players walk onto Centre Court, hearing the roar of the crowd, and witnessing moments that go down in sports history. Whether you're a tennis fan or just love great sports drama, Wimbledon is a must-watch — classy, thrilling, and full of unforgettable moments.

programme.title: EuroLeague. Baskonia Vitoria-Gasteiz - Virtus Bologna
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.desc: Asia's natural world is full of weird wildlife. programme.title: Snakes in the City
programme.desc: Catching the world's deadliest snakes is no problem for Simon Keys and his partner Siouxsie Gillett, who round up Durban's ever-growing population of street snakes. With the summer heat enticing the snakes into the city, it's the duo's job to safely catch the slithering creatures and release them safely back into the wild. Entering homes, offices and even factories, the reclusive reptiles seek to find shelter in places you wouldn't think likely. From black mambas to cobras, Simon and Siouxsie have their work cut out as they race to help the residents of Durban stay safe from a potentially lethal snakebite.

programme.title: Snakes in the City
programme.desc: Catching the world's deadliest snakes is no problem for Simon Keys and his partner Siouxsie Gillett, who round up Durban's ever-growing population of street snakes. Entering homes, offices and even factories, the reclusive reptiles seek to find shelter in places you wouldn't think likely. From black mambas to cobras, Simon and Siouxsie have their work cut out as they race to help the residents of Durban stay safe from a potentially lethal snakebite.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pol's rush to prepare for their farm's first Michigan winter. The family goes into hyperdrive to fix the pasture fence and finish building the garden hardscape before the first snow falls. Beth is worried about the bees, so she brings in some expert help to hopefully ensure their survival.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: It's winter on the farm, and the Pol's are adding to their flock! The family is bringing in four merino ewes that were recently bred, which means with any luck the farm could be expecting its first lambs come springtime. And as winter fades into spring, the Pol's prepare for the new arrivals by building a lambing pen. Meanwhile, Beth checks if her bees survived the winter.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pol's are preparing for sheep to give birth, which means figuring out how to catch and shear their four Merino ewes - no small task as this is new territory for everyone except Dr. Pol. Then, while helping his dad on a farm call, Charles has a terrifying accident. The whole family rallies together to care for Charles and take care of the farm.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: It's been a year of farming for the Pol family. Even with Charles recovering from his injury, the farm's showing no signs of slowing down! Beth takes the next step with her bees to grow the colony and harvest honey. Charles and Ben come up with a final fix for the sheep hut's drainage problem. The whole family comes together to plant the garden and celebrate a successful year on the farm.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

In the leafy canopy, Phil encounters the elusive tree kangaroo and its young joey, as well as Australia's largest snake, the lethal scrub python. On the forest floor, the colorful cassowary acts as the rainforest's gardener.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Within the Channel Country deserts, Indigenous educator Phil Breslin scours the endless sands to find three animals that not only survive the heat but thrive in unrelenting conditions. Get ready to meet Australia's most impressive animals: the perentie, the continent's largest lizard; the emu, its fastest flightless bird; and the mighty red kangaroo, the world's largest marsupial.

programme.title: Equator's Wild Secrets
programme.desc: At zero degrees latitude, the equator is the imaginary line that runs across the middle of our spheroid planet, passing through 13 countries that are home to diverse and wild ecosystems. In this six-part documentary series, we explore a wonderful natural area in each episode, revealing its stunning and unique wildlife. The team travel to the Galapagos islands, the Andes mountains, the Amazon rainforest, Africa, Borneo and Sumatra, and the coral seas that thrive off the abundant, equatorial sunlight, showcasing the vastly contrasting environments that are dotted along the equator.

programme.title: Wild India
programme.desc: India's monsoon forest is a place of both sanctuary and extremes. From the dry season drought to the monsoon deluge, all must live by the law of the seasons. Whether migrating, raising young or defending against predators, every day is a quest for survival. As the dry season tightens its grip, only the most ingenious and resourceful will endure until the lifesaving rains return.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol Compilations
programme.desc: There's not much that Dr. Jan Pol hasn't seen throughout his long, veterinarian career. The Dutch-born veterinarian has been helping animals since he graduated from Utrecht University in 1970. In this series we look back at memorable moments from his reality series, The Incredible Dr. Pol, where alongside his employees and his family he helps nurse a variety of creatures back to health from his Michigan-based practice. His clients come in all shapes and sizes, often needing urgent medical assistance, something that Dr. Jan Pol lives for. The passionate veterinarian is always keen to help, and we revisit the original series' greatest moments.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: Animals survive by using camouflage, mimicry, and stealth tactics. From tigers who hunt in plain sight using their orange fur as camouflage, and a spider who mimics an ant to sneak into a colony, to a bird that uses false alarm calls to trick meerkats into giving up their prey, nature deploys remarkable deception to survive.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: In nature, the prevailing rule is "eat or be eaten." Avoiding predators and competition for space, food, and mates is a priority for every animal. But before you can attack, you need to be able to defend yourself. After eons of evolution, animals have developed powerful and surprising defensive techniques that help them avoid, overcome, or escape challengers.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: Animals wage a covert war for survival, deploying their hidden weapons with deadly precision. These adaptations, forged by eons of evolution, give animals the edge they need to outwit predators, rivals, and the elements. From the bombardier beetle's boiling spray to the mantis shrimp's explosive club and the draco lizard's hidden wings, meet nature's awesome secret weapons.

programme.title: Hidden Wonders of Europe
programme.desc: The parched lands of the Iberian Peninsula give rise to snow-covered peaks, expanses of rare cork oak, and Europe's only fog forest. Unique habitats, where species found nowhere else on earth fight for survival. Male Iberian Ibex face-off over females, a whiskered tern chick braves predator-infested waters, and settling the score for the Macaques of Gibraltar calls for kidnap.

programme.title: Hidden Wonders of Europe
programme.desc: Germany is Europe's most populous nation. A land hewn by mighty rivers and cloaked in forest. In these wild spaces, nature is full of surprises. From the Bavarian mountains to the North Sea, over a third of the country is now protected. Huge Grey Seals battle to breed, Marmots and Squirrels flee aerial invaders, and elusive Lynx and Moose - once hunted out - re-assert their grip.

programme.title: Hidden Wonders of Europe
programme.desc: Few of Europe's countries boast the wide and wondrous variety of animals found in Greece. Its mainland is dubbed the 'Serengeti of Europe', while the coast is home to Europe's largest marine reserve. Greece is a land brimming with natural treasures. Hidden hunters feast on migrating birds, a scorpion searches for his soulmate, and young seal pups venture out into the unknown.

programme.desc: Feline Fervor: King Julien is literally bounced out of his kingdom and onto the New York streets. A kindly old lady thinks he's a cat and swoops him up. Action Reaction: Skipper is forced to live his worst nightmare when he's doused with Inflatium and stress causes him to blow up like a balloon. Guess what this means… no more going on missions! programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Mental Hen: Kowalski has a rival, if you even can call it a rivalry. A Delaware Blue Hen has taken up residence at the zoo, and she has the amazing ability to predict the future! Kowalski doesn't buy the psychic chicken hype and sets out to discredit her. The truth turns out to be far more sinister than a simple sports-pickin' chicken, and Kowalski will have to use all his best moves to wiggle out of this mess. Thumb Drive: The penguins need a thumb, and Maurice's fits the bill nicely. Using the opposable digit thumbprint to break into a secret weapons lab gets the penguins all atwitter. King Julien is unhappy that his right hand man is running around on missions with the birds so he sets out to sabotage the mission. As with most of King Julien's plans, this scheme turns out to be "thumbs down"!

programme.title: Max and the Midknights
programme.desc: When Uncle Budrick is held captive as King Gastley's jester, it's up to Max to rescue him, with a little help from her new friends, Simon, Millie, and Kevyn. Max attempts to enlist the help of a wizard named Mumblin, but learns that he's retired and unwilling to aid in their mission. Afraid that she will put her new friends in more danger, Max goes off on her own to rescue Uncle Budrick, but is surprised when Simon, Millie, & Kevyn follow her, determined to help. The four later find themselves mixed up in a royal jousting event, where they are chased by a wild boar. Luckily, Mumblin decides to help and appears, just in time to save them. With Mumblin now on their side, Max and co. attempt to rescue Uncle Budrick, but when a tentacled creature emerges from the moat, Max and the others must flee without Uncle Budrick. Now bonded as a group, Max, Simon, Millie, and Kevyn, vow to return to save Uncle Budrick, together. Their mission clear, the newly formed team decide on their new nickname: the Midknights.

programme.title: Football: French Ligue 1
programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. Ligue 1 is currently full of well-organised football teams and incredible European talent, who are a complement to the sport. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

programme.title: L'ora più buia
programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Gary Oldman nel film che racconta i primi turbolenti giorni da Primo Ministro di Winston Churchill. Nel 1940, il celebre statista inglese deve affrontare l'avanzata dei nazisti e prendere decisioni drammatiche per il bene del suo paese, ma deve fare i conti con lo scettico re e con alcuni membri del suo partito che sembrano tramare contro di lui. Oscar anche al trucco. La pellicola è stato candidata anche per la sceneggiatura, scritta da Anthony McCarten che aveva firmato anche un altro fortunato biopic, “La teoria del tutto”.

programme.title: Joker: Folie à Deux
programme.desc: Joaquin Phoenix riveste i panni del folle personaggio della DC Comics in uno sbalorditivo sequel con Lady Gaga. Internato nel manicomio di Arkham in attesa del processo per i crimini commessi, Arthur Fleck si innamora di Lee Quinzel, una paziente affascinata dalla figura del Joker.

programme.title: L'orto americano
programme.desc: Dal suo romanzo, Pupi Avanti dirige Filippo Scotti in un film dalle atmosfere sospese. Nei giorni della Liberazione, un ragazzo si innamora di un'infermiera dell'esercito americano.

programme.title: Vangelo secondo Maria
programme.desc: Benedetta Porcaroli e' Maria e Alessandro Gassmann e' Giuseppe nella pellicola Sky Original diretta da Paolo Zucca e tratta dall'omonimo romanzo di Barbara Alberti.

programme.title: Blue Jasmine
programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Cate Blanchett in una pellicola di Woody Allen. Una donna in crisi lascia New York e si trasferisce a San Francisco per rimettere ordine nella sua vita.

programme.title: A proposito di Schmidt
programme.desc: 2 Golden Globe al film di Alexander Payne con Jack Nicholson e Kathy Bates. Un vedovo attraversa l'America in un viaggio alla scoperta delle sue emozioni più profonde.

programme.title: L’innocenza
programme.desc: Miglior sceneggiatura a Cannes 2023 per il delicato film di Hirokazu Kore'eda. Un preadolescente, vittima di un professore, è difeso dalla madre. Ma la verità è incerta.

programme.title: Radioactive
programme.desc: Rosamund Pike, Sam Riley e Anya Taylor-Joy nella biografia di Marie Curie. La vita della scienziata polacca, naturalizzata francese, che ha cambiato il mondo con le sue scoperte, salendo in cattedra in una società dominata dagli uomini e aggiudicandosi per due volte il Nobel.

programme.title: Alla vita
programme.desc: Riccardo Scamarcio e Lou de Laage nell'opera prima di Stephane Freiss. Una giovane, di famiglia ebrea ortodossa, incontra un uomo con cui esplora il desiderio di ribellarsi alla tradizione.

programme.title: First Man - Il primo uomo
programme.desc: Ryan Gosling e' Neil Armstrong nel biopic di Damien Chazelle premiato con 1 Oscar e 1 Golden Globe. America, anni 60: la storia della missione spaziale che porto' alla conquista della Luna.

programme.title: Mountainhead
programme.desc: Dal creatore di "Succession", una pungente satira targata HBO con Steve Carell e Jason Schwartzman. 4 amici milionari si riuniscono sullo sfondo di una crisi globale.

programme.title: The Wolf of Wall Street
programme.desc: Golden Globe a Leonardo DiCaprio nel biopic di Martin Scorsese con Margot Robbie. L'incredibile ascesa di Jordan Belfort, un broker attratto dalla sete di potere e da una vita dissoluta.

programme.title: Ore 15:17 - Attacco al treno
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood affronta la piaga del terrorismo dirigendo un dramma tratto da una storia vera, interpretata dagli eroi che l'hanno realmente vissuta. Spencer Stone, Alek Skarlatos e Anthony Sadler sono tre ragazzi di Sacramento, amici di lunga data, che stanno passando le vacanze in giro per l'Europa. E il 21 agosto del 2015 si trovano a bordo del treno Thalys 9364 diretto da Amsterdam a Parigi. Il treno, con a bordo circa 500 passeggeri, è anche l'obiettivo dell'Isis, ma saranno proprio Spencer, Alek e Anthony a sventare l'attentato, trasformandosi da persone comuni a eroi.

programme.title: Giu' la testa
programme.desc: Western restaurato di Sergio Leone con James Coburn e Rod Steiger. Un fuorilegge messicano si allea con un rapinatore irlandese e si trova a combattere per la Rivoluzione di Villa e Zapata.

programme.title: Alla vita
programme.desc: Riccardo Scamarcio e Lou de Laage nell'opera prima di Stephane Freiss. Una giovane, di famiglia ebrea ortodossa, incontra un uomo con cui esplora il desiderio di ribellarsi alla tradizione.

programme.title: L'ultimo giorno sulla Terra
programme.desc: Sci-fi movie con Jean Reno e Hugo Becker, opera prima di Romain Quirot. 2050: un planetoide ha desertificato il globo e ora sta per distruggerlo. Paul e' l'unico astronauta che puo' fermarlo.

programme.title: Ore 15:17 - Attacco al treno
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood affronta la piaga del terrorismo dirigendo un dramma tratto da una storia vera, interpretata dagli eroi che l'hanno realmente vissuta. programme.title: Nowhere Special - Una storia d'amore
programme.desc: Uberto Pasolini dirige un film struggente con James Norton e Daniel Lamont. Affetto da una malattia incurabile, John vuole trovare una famiglia per suo figlio di quattro anni.

programme.title: La sfida delle mogli
programme.desc: Peter Cattaneo ("Full Monty") dirige un biopic al femminile con Kristin Scott Thomas. Per sopportare l'assenza dei mariti in missione in Afghanistan, alcune donne formano un coro musicale.

programme.title: The Wolf of Wall Street
programme.desc: Golden Globe a Leonardo DiCaprio nel biopic di Martin Scorsese con Margot Robbie. L'incredibile ascesa di Jordan Belfort, un broker attratto dalla sete di potere e da una vita dissoluta.

programme.title: Senza sangue
programme.desc: Angelina Jolie dirige Salma Hayek in un intenso dramma ispirato al romanzo di Alessandro Baricco. Una donna ritrova dopo anni uno dei responsabili del massacro della sua famiglia e deve decidere come sia giusto vendicarsi.

programme.title: Mrs Lowry & Son
programme.desc: Timothy Spall e Vanessa Redgrave nella biografia del pittore britannico L. S. Lowry. Figlio di una donna che scoraggia quotidianamente le sue ambizioni, l’aspirante artista lavora ogni giorno con l’obiettivo di dipingere un quadro che possa rendere la madre fiera di lui.

programme.title: The Hurt Locker
programme.desc: 6 Oscar per il capolavoro di Kathryn Bigelow con Jeremy Renner protagonista. In Iraq, una squadra di artificieri statunitensi viene inviata sul posto per una pericolosa missione.

programme.title: L'ultimo giorno sulla Terra
programme.desc: Sci-fi movie con Jean Reno e Hugo Becker, opera prima di Romain Quirot. 2050: un planetoide ha desertificato il globo e ora sta per distruggerlo. Paul e' l'unico astronauta che puo' fermarlo.

programme.title: Babygirl
programme.desc: Coppa Volpi a Venezia a Nicole Kidman in un dramma erotico con Harris Dickinson e Antonio Banderas. Una donna sposata, amministratice delegata di un'azienda importante, inizia una relazione clandestina con un giovane stagista che la trascina in una spirale di perversione.

programme.title: Boogie Nights - L'altra Hollywood
programme.desc: Paul Thomas Anderson firma l'epopea di un promettente pornoattore, interpretato da Mark Wahlberg, sullo sfondo dei trasgressivi anni 70. Nel cast Heather Graham e Julianne Moore.

programme.title: Kiss Kiss Bang Bang
programme.desc: Ricatti e omicidi in un thriller con Val Kilmer, Robert Downey Jr e Michelle Monaghan. Una serie di coincidenze porta un ladro a recitare in un film. Finirà in un torbido giro.

programme.title: Bumblebee
programme.desc: Hailee Steinfeld e John Cena nello spin off della saga di "Transformers", prodotto da Steven Spielberg. In missione sulla Terra, un Autobot rimane ferito e si trasforma in un Maggiolino.

programme.title: Transformers 4 - L'era dell'estinzione
programme.desc: Mark Wahlberg nel quarto capitolo della saga dedicata ai personaggi della Hasbro. Alcuni anni dopo la distruzione di Chicago, un inventore ritrova Optimus Prime, il leader degli Autobot.

programme.title: Transformers - L'ultimo cavaliere
programme.desc: Mark Wahlberg e Anthony Hopkins nel quinto capitolo della saga diretta da Michael Bay. Un'inaspettata alleanza e' l'unica possibilita' per salvare la Terra da una minaccia spaziale.

programme.title: Transformers One
programme.desc: Il prequel totalmente animato della saga sci-fi e' un'origin story che narra l'amicizia dei futuri nemici giurati Optimus Prime e Megatron, in fuga dalla Cyberton sotterranea, e il momento in cui acquisiscono i loro poteri.

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: Shia LaBeouf e Megan Fox nel primo capitolo della saga sci-fi prodotta da Steven Spielberg. Due razze aliene, gli Autobots e i Decepticons, scelgono la Terra come campo di battaglia.

programme.title: Transformers - La vendetta del caduto
programme.desc: Secondo capitolo della spettacolare saga con Megan Fox, Shia LaBeouf e i celebri robot. I Decepticon sfidano gli Autobot e gli umani nel tentativo di risvegliare il loro capo assoluto.

programme.title: Transformers 3
programme.desc: Michael Bay dirige Shia LaBeouf e John Turturro nel terzo capitolo della saga prodotta da Steven Spielberg. Gli Autobot devono difendersi dai Decepticons e da un nuovo terribile nemico.

programme.title: Il padrino della mafia
programme.desc: Sergio Castellitto in un thriller sulla mafia canadese. L'erede di una dinastia di sarti, che da generazioni veste il clan dei Paternò, è pronto a tutto per guadagnarsi la fiducia del boss.

programme.title: La legge della notte
programme.desc: Ben Affleck dirige e interpreta un noir ambientato negli anni del proibizionismo. Un veterano della Prima guerra mondiale ripudia gli insegnamenti del padre diventando un criminale.

programme.title: Black Mass - L'ultimo gangster
programme.desc: La storia vera del criminale James 'Whitey' Bulger con Johnny Depp e Benedict Cumberbatch. Anni '70: un gangster irlandese collabora con l'Fbi per incastrare i rivali della mafia italiana.

programme.title: Iddu - L'ultimo Padrino
programme.desc: Toni Servillo ed Elio Germano nel film liberamente ispirato ad un periodo della vita di Matteo Messina Denaro. Sicilia: in cambio della libertà, un politico condannato per associazione mafiosa collabora con la giustizia per catturare il boss latitante.

programme.title: Gangster Squad
programme.desc: Josh Brolin, Ryan Gosling e Sean Penn in un poliziesco tratto da una storia vera. Los Angeles, anni 40: una squadra di agenti incorruttibili lotta per colpire al cuore l'impero di un gangster.

programme.title: C'era una volta in America
programme.desc: Versione estesa e restaurata del capolavoro di Sergio Leone con Robert De Niro sulle note di Ennio Morricone. L'ascesa e il declino di due gangster divisi dall'amore per la stessa donna.

programme.title: Capone
programme.desc: Biopic sul famoso gangster con Tom Hardy, Linda Cardellini, Matt Dillon e Kyle MacLachlan. Uscito dal carcere, Al Capone ripercorre il suo passato mentre lotta contro la demenza senile.

programme.title: Il padrino della mafia
programme.desc: Sergio Castellitto in un thriller sulla mafia canadese. L'erede di una dinastia di sarti, che da generazioni veste il clan dei Paternò, è pronto a tutto per guadagnarsi la fiducia del boss.

programme.title: Nemico pubblico
programme.desc: Michael Mann dirige Johnny Depp, Christian Bale e Marion Cotillard nella biografia di John Dillinger, il famigerato gangster che impaurì e affascinò l’America degli anni 30.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Gangster
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova si sfidano a colpi di criminali e malavitosi di ogni genere per parlarci dei film disponibili su Sky Cinema.

programme.title: Trolls
programme.desc: Dai creatori di "Shrek", un film d'animazione con le allegre creature dal ciuffo ribelle. La principessa Poppy e il malinconico Branch devono salvare i Trolls dai loro mortali nemici.

programme.title: I Croods
programme.desc: Avventura nella preistoria firmata DreamWorks. Alla ricerca di un rifugio dopo un terremoto, il cavernicolo Grug e la sua famiglia scoprono un mondo popolato da fantastiche creature.

programme.title: Ant Bully - Una vita da formica
programme.desc: John A. Davis, autore e regista di "Jimmy Neutron", firma un cartoon prodotto da Tom Hanks. Stufe dei dispetti del piccolo Lucas, le formiche decidono di rimpicciolirlo usando una pozione.

programme.title: Il lupo e il leone
programme.desc: Tenera avventura dai creatori di "Mia e il leone bianco". Giunta nei boschi del Canada dopo la morte del nonno, una giovane pianista si prende cura di un lupacchiotto e un leoncino.

programme.title: Harry Potter e l'Ordine della Fenice
programme.desc: Quinta avventura per Daniel Radcliffe nei panni di Harry Potter. Il giovane mago scopre l'esistenza di un'associazione segreta che vuole uccidere Voldemort, che sta per tornare a Hogwarts.

programme.title: Harry Potter e il principe mezzosangue
programme.desc: David Yates dirige la sesta avventura della saga. Un manuale misterioso insegna a Harry Potter i segreti della magia nera, ma per sconfiggere Voldemort avrà bisogno di Lumacorno.

programme.title: I Croods
programme.desc: Avventura nella preistoria firmata DreamWorks. Alla ricerca di un rifugio dopo un terremoto, il cavernicolo Grug e la sua famiglia scoprono un mondo popolato da fantastiche creature.

programme.title: Un oggi alla volta
programme.desc: Coinvolgente storia d'amore con Ginevra Francesconi e Tommaso Cassissa. Un numero di telefono memorizzato male porta due ragazzi, diversissimi tra loro, a conoscersi.

programme.title: Belle & Sebastien - L'avventura continua
programme.desc: Secondo film tratto dai romanzi di Cecile Aubry. Sebastien non crede alla morte di Angelina e parte alla sua ricerca insieme a Belle. Durante il viaggio, una scoperta cambiera' la sua vita.

programme.title: La bussola d'oro
programme.desc: Un Oscar al fantasy con Daniel Craig e Nicole Kidman, dal romanzo di Philip Pullman. Una bambina e il suo 'daimon' devono sfidare una strega in un luogo popolato da strane creature.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Transformers
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova si confrontano sulla serie dei film Transformers.

programme.title: Troppo Napoletano
programme.desc: Commedia di Gianluca Ansanelli con Serena Rossi e prodotta da Alessandro Siani. In preda ai primi turbamenti d'amore, il piccolo Ciro si allea con il suo analista per conquistare l'amata.

programme.title: Paws of Fury: La leggenda di Hank
programme.desc: Travolgente avventura animata targata Sky Original. Hank, un adorabile cane che sogna di diventare samurai, prende lezioni da un maestro, ma un perfido gatto minaccia il villaggio.

programme.title: Harry Potter e i doni della morte: Parte I
programme.desc: Prima parte dell'adattamento dell'ultimo romanzo di J.K. Rowling. Insieme a Hermione e Ron, Harry deve trovare e distruggere gli horcrux, oggetti contenenti l'anima del Signore Oscuro.

programme.title: Harry Potter e i doni della morte: Parte II
programme.desc: Gran finale della saga in un tripudio di effetti speciali. Alla ricerca degli ultimi horcrux, Harry torna a Hogwarts, ma Voldemort ha scoperto la sua missione...

programme.title: Trash
programme.desc: Tenera avventura animata, opera prima di Francesco Dafano e Luca Della Grotta. Slim, una scatola logora, e la bottiglia ammaccata Bubbles accompagnano il piccolo Spark, una batteria usata, alla ricerca della Piramide magica: il luogo dove tutti i rifiuti possono avere una seconda chance.

programme.title: The Portable Door
programme.desc: Dai libri fantasy di Tom Hol, film Sky Original con Christoph Waltz, Sam Neill e Patrick Gibson. Londra: due tirocinanti scoprono che i loro capi vogliono sabotare il mondo della magia.

programme.title: Belle & Sebastien - Amici per sempre
programme.desc: Terzo avventuroso capitolo tratto dal romanzo di Cecile Aubry. Un uomo sostiene di essere il proprietario di Belle; ma Sebastien farà di tutto per non separarsi dalla fedele amica.

programme.title: Harry Potter e la pietra filosofale
programme.desc: Primo capitolo della saga con Daniel Radcliffe. Dotato di poteri speciali, il piccolo Harry Potter inizia la sua avventura alla scuola di magia di Hogwarts e affronta il malvagio Voldemort.

programme.title: Il robot selvaggio
programme.desc: Emozionante animazione targata DreamWorks diretta da Chris Sanders e candidata a 3 Oscar. Precipitato su un'isola, un robot viene incidentalmente attivato dalla fauna locale.

programme.desc: Un implacabile conto alla rovescia scandisce un thriller con Elizabeth Lail. Lo scetticismo e il pensiero razionale non sembrano arginare il suo terrore perché chiunque altro abbia scaricato la stessa app muore nel momento indicato sul display. programme.desc: Sam Claflin in una commedia romantica targata Sky Original. In Messico per promuovere il suo libro uno scrittore inglese scopre che la traduttrice lo ha trasformato in un romanzo erotico.

programme.desc: Julia Roberts e Richard Gere di nuovo insieme nella commedia romantica dal regista di "Pretty Woman". Ike Graham e' un cronista di New York in cerca di un'idea per il prossimo pezzo da consegnare al suo capo, la sua ex moglie. Per caso, in un bar, sente parlare di una donna, Maggie Carpenter, che piu' di una volta ha abbandonato sull'altare i suoi fidanzati. Ike le dedica il suo prossimo articolo, finendo per scatenare l'ira della donna che ne ottiene il licenziamento. Ma Ike non si da' per vinto e decide di fare un viaggio fino nel Maryland per scoprire la verita'.

programme.title: L'amore e altre seghe mentali
programme.desc: Commedia romantica di e con Giampaolo Morelli e Maria Chiara Giannetta. Dopo una delusione d'amore Guido è diventato cinico, ma l'incontro con Giulia potrebbe fargli cambiare idea.

programme.title: New in Town - Una single in carriera

programme.title: Little Italy - Pizza, amore e fantasia
programme.desc: Emma Roberts e Hayden Christensen in una commedia romantica nel cuore italiano di Toronto. Una giovane coppia di innamorati deve resistere all'accesa rivalita' tra i rispettivi genitori.

programme.title: Vacanze romane
programme.desc: Tre Oscar e un Golden Globe per un intramontabile classico della commedia con Gregory Peck e Audrey Hepburn. Un principessa in visita nella Capitale fugge dai rigidi cerimoniali e conosce un reporter americano con cui vivra' una romantica avventura. Ma lo scoop e' in agguato...

programme.title: Proposta indecente
programme.desc: Demi Moore, Woody Harrelson e Robert Redford nell'indimenticabile pellicola firmata dal regista di "Nove settimane e mezzo" e "Attrazione fatale". Diana e David sono una coppia felicemente sposata ma in cattive acque dal punto di vista economico, tanto da tentare la fortuna fra i tavoli e le slot machine di Las Vegas. In loro soccorso arriva l'allettante proposta di un ricco miliardario: un milione di dollari in cambio di una sola notte d'amore con la donna. Dopo molti dubbi, Diana e David decidono di accettare l'offerta ma le conseguenze saranno devastanti...

programme.title: Due partite
programme.desc: Commedia dolce-amara sul mondo femminile con un cast di stelle italiane. Anni 60: quattro amiche si incontrano per confidarsi. Trent'anni dopo è la volta delle loro figlie.

programme.desc: Dal romanzo di Jane Austen, una storia di intese amorose con Gwyneth Paltrow. 1800: una giovane aristocratica inglese aiuta una ragazza timida a trovare l'uomo giusto. Oscar alle musiche.

Connor Mead è un celebre fotografo che ha un enorme fascino sulle donne: nessuna riesce a resistergli, e lui da cinico playboy passa da un'avventura all'altra. Per lui non esistono relazioni stabili, tanto meno il matrimonio. E di questo cerca di convincere anche il fratello minore, che invece sta per sposarsi, ma i fantasmi delle sue numerose ex cominciano a perseguitarlo, mostrandogli quello che sarà il suo futuro. Nel cast, anche Michael Douglas.

programme.title: A Mistake
programme.desc: Elizabeth Banks in un medical-drama dal romanzo di Carl Shuker. La dottoressa Taylor è un rinomato chirurgo che commette un fatale errore durante un'operazione di routine. Isolata dai vertici dell'ospedale, affronta il tracollo della sua vita professionale e privata.

programme.title: Il tempo che ci vuole

programme.title: Hereafter
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood dirige Matt Damon e sonda il mistero della morte. La vita di un uomo che parla con i defunti si intreccia con il drammatico vissuto di una donna e di un bambino.

programme.title: La pazza gioia
programme.desc: Valeria Bruni Tedeschi e Micaela Ramazzotti nel road movie al femminile di Paolo Virzì. Due donne fuggono da una clinica psichiatrica e si avventurano a riassaporare il mondo.

programme.title: Non odiare
programme.desc: Alessandro Gassmann e Sara Serraiocco nell'opera prima di Mauro Mancini, ispirata a una storia vera. Un chirurgo ebreo lascia morire un uomo, ferito in un incidente, per una svastica tatuata sul petto. Turbato dai sensi di colpa, assume la figlia della vittima come colf.

programme.title: Anime nere
programme.desc: Dal romanzo di Gioacchino Criaco, un viaggio infernale nel cuore della 'Ndrangheta. In un paesino dell'Aspromonte, l'atto intimidatorio del ventenne Leo nei confronti di un clan rivale riunisce dopo molti anni tre fratelli. Luciano, padre di Leo, vive ancora in Calabria ed e' attaccato alle radici rurali della famiglia. Luigi e Rocco, invece, si sono arricchiti al nord: il primo come narcotrafficante, il secondo entrando nel mondo dell'imprenditoria grazie a un giro di soldi sporchi. La provocazione di Leo li costringera' a un sanguinoso regolamento di conti con il passato.

programme.title: Non sono quello che sono
programme.desc: Edoardo Leo scrive, dirige e interpreta un adattamento dell’Otello di Shakespeare ambientando la vicenda nel 2001, all’interno di un’organizzazione criminale sul litorale romano.

programme.title: Nour
programme.desc: Sergio Castellitto nella pellicola di Maurizio Zaccaro sulla complessa realtà degli sbarchi dei migranti. Un dottore di stanza a Lampedusa prende a cuore il caso di una bambina siriana.

programme.title: Ciclismo: Parigi-Roubaix maschile
programme.desc: La Parigi-Roubaix è una corsa in linea maschile di ciclismo su strada, una delle cinque cosiddette classiche monumento, che si svolge nel nord della Francia, in prossimità della frontiera belga, ogni anno la seconda domenica d'aprile. La distanza totale della corsa supera i 250 km variando a seconda delle edizioni. Dal 1989 è stata inserita nel calendario della Coppa del Mondo e dal 2005 in quello dell'UCI ProTour.

This unique boxing show offers all-round entertainment, with live performances, lavish costumes and real fights with blood!

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called “Kung Fu Stuntmen”. This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: Iron Squad W
programme.desc: The fourth season of this Korean military survival show will determine the most elite female soldier. It brings together six Special Force units to compete in challenging missions across land, sea, and air. Top female reservists form teams of four to compete against one another. Witness how they battle to the end in front of six celebrity hosts!

programme.title: Night Walk
programme.desc: Frank is framed for murder after his girlfriend is killed in a tragic incident during their visit to the Middle East. He is sent to a prison where he meets a Muslim inmate who helps him plan for a prison escape to prove his innocence. When his friend suddenly dies, can Frank successfully escape and seek justice for himself?

programme.title: Operation Bangkok
programme.desc: Military veteran Wu and undercover cop Ming rescue hostages on an island near Bangkok. Just as the mission is completed and they prepare to leave, Wu discovers his daughter has also been captured. Determined to save her, he stays with Ming to fight the thugs and rescue her.

programme.title: Sari Saring Sine: Hindi Pa Tapos ang Laban
programme.desc: Fernando Poe Jr. stars as Carding Villamar, a city professional who returns to their hometown of Evangelista after learning of his brother's untimely demise. As a series of events unfold, he soon discovers that his brother didn't succumb to a heart attack as he was made to believe. He was shot in cold blood for refusing to sell his land to a powerful congressman. With a town muted and crippled by fear, the congressman's henchmen move unhampered to silence Carding and his brother's orphaned family as well. Big mistake. Armed with only a crusty riffle and a whole ton of rage. Carding sets out to right the wrong and exact vengeance for the murder of his brother. That is, if he survives the hot pursuits of bounty hunters, the militia and the police who are all in the congressman's payroll.

As a series of events unfold, he soon discovers that his brother didn't succumb to a heart attack as he was made to believe. He was shot in cold blood for refusing to sell his land to a powerful congressman. With a town muted and crippled by fear, the congressman's henchmen move unhampered to silence Carding and his brother's orphaned family as well. Big mistake. Armed with only a crusty riffle and a whole ton of rage. Carding sets out to right the wrong and exact vengeance for the murder of his brother. That is, if he survives the hot pursuits of bounty hunters, the militia and the police who are all in the congressman's payroll.

When the child Arthur's father is murdered, Vortigern (Jude Law), Arthur's uncle, seizes the crown. Robbed of his birthright and with no idea who he truly is, Arthur comes up the hard way in the back alleys of the city. programme.desc: A collection of outrageous problems that you have never heard of!A great 'knowledge talk show' where problematic children who are struggling and fighting in the emotional rooftop room gain true wisdom about life and the world.

programme.title: Marie and Her Three Daddies
programme.desc: Marie's turbulent journey to find her father leads to the birth of an eccentric new family, one that proves stronger than blood and more persistent than DNA.

programme.title: A Graceful Liar
programme.desc: A bold yet heartbreaking story of a mother and daughter-in-law who meet through marriage and wage a war of lies to seize the Geonhyang family, struggling for a dramatic reversal of fortune.

programme.title: Cinderella Game
programme.desc: A story of a woman who realizes the meaning of true revenge while she has been used as a fake daughter by her enemy.

programme.title: Our Golden Days

programme.title: The Seasons
programme.desc: A talk show brings you music and stories that will "get rid of all your worries and all your concerns.".

programme.title: Uncontrollably Fond
programme.desc: It's a love story of a man and woman who meet again after they broke up in the past. The man, in the presence of his death, wishes to make amends. Their romance will have you seek comfort and hope in love.

programme.title: My Neighbor, Charles
programme.desc: Foreigners, leaving their homelands behind, have come all the way to new country, South Korea. They chose South Korea not for sightseeing or short-term stay. But, they are here for various reasons, such as work, study or even marriage. The real stories of foreigners who challenge themselves to survive in Korean society will be unfolded!

programme.title: Moving Voices in Spain
programme.desc: When you try to understand a country, is there anything that reveals more than its music? "Moving Voices" follows Korea's artists travelling to different places around the world. What kind of music and stories will these singers share, as they understand the culture and people from the world?

programme.title: Boss in the Mirror

programme.title: Are You Human?
programme.desc: A young man falls into a coma. His mother creates an artificial intelligence robot in his likeness that must pretend to be a real human and fool people into believing that he's real until the real son wakes up. He is placed in the midst of a fierce power struggle of a business mogul family in the young man's stead. There's a woman who protects him as a bodyguard but doesn't even know if he's a human or a robot!

programme.title: NCIS

programme.desc: Tim NCIS menggelar sebuah pernikahan palsu untuk dua anggotanya sendiri dalam upaya menjatuhkan sekelompok mafia.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Tim NCIS menyelidiki kasus kematian seorang letnan Angkatan Laut di sebuah bank darah. Di sisi lain, McGee mencari dukungan tim untuk penggalangan dana di sekolah anak kembarnya.

programme.title: NCIS

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Usai kematian seorang Letnan Angkatan Laut, Torres dan Knight berhasil mengungkap kasus pembunuhan yang terkait ke sebuah keluarga kaya. Sementara itu, Parker menemukan keterkaitan antara kematian ibunya dengan Lily.

programme.desc: Tim NCIS bergegas untuk mengungkap dalang yang memerintahkan pembunuhan terhadap Kepala Angkatan Laut setelah mereka berhasil menangkap seorang pembunuh bayaran yang dikenal sebagai The Poet.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Saat tiga anggota veteran ditemukan tewas terbunuh di kamar motel di D.C., tim NCIS melacak seorang tersangka yang menolak untuk berbicara dengan siapa pun kecuali Sam Hanna.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Karier dan kredibilitas McGee dipertaruhkan saat ia menyelidiki sebuah kasus korupsi yang melibatkan wakil direktur. Di sisi lain, Torres dan Knight menerima beberapa kabar nan mengejutkan.

programme.desc: Saat tim NCIS menyelidiki hubungan berbahaya antara kartel Nexus dan musuh lama Parker, bos mafia Carla Marino, tim menguak sebuah rencana mematikan yang melibatkan bahan nuklir hasil curian.

programme.title: Casino Royale
programme.desc: James Bond, the renowned secret agent, must prevent Le Chiffre, an evil banker, from winning a high-stakes poker game. However, things get complicated when he enters the tournament himself.

programme.title: Rambo III
programme.desc: When his former superior, Colonel Samuel, asks him to join him on a special mission in Afghanistan, Rambo declines. However, when he is held hostage and tortured, Rambo decides to step in.

programme.title: Wild Card
programme.desc: Nick works as a bodyguard while trying to overcome his gambling addiction. However, his life takes a turn when he learns of a brutal attack on his friend and sets out on a bloody quest for revenge.

programme.title: Vehicle 19
programme.desc: Michael Woods, a traveller and a parolee, picks up the wrong rental car to meet his wife which makes him the prime target of a group of corrupt police officers.

programme.title: The Kid
programme.desc: After a woman abandons her child, the Tramp finds him and takes him under his wing. As the boy grows up, the Tramp and the boy try to cope with life's trials and tribulations.

programme.title: The Starving Games
programme.desc: In a deadly game orchestrated by President Snowballs, skilled archer Kantmiss Evershot, her boyfriend Dale and tech-savvy ally Peter Malarkey must rely on their wits and skills to survive.

programme.title: Tracers
programme.desc: Cam, a bike messenger, is wanted by the Chinese mafia and he is on the run while learning parkour after crashing into a beautiful woman.

programme.title: Let Me In
programme.desc: Owen leads a lonely life and is bullied by his peers at school. He happily befriends Abby, his new helpful neighbour, without being aware that she is hiding a secret from him.

programme.title: The LEGO Movie 2: The Second Part
programme.desc: Five years after saving the Lego world, Emmet must once again save everyone with the help of Rex Dangervest when new enemies from outer space attack them.

programme.title: Rush Hour 3
programme.desc: Inspector Lee and Detective Carter arrive in Paris following an assassination attempt on Ambassador Han. There, they encounter a woman who may hold the key to uncovering the Triad's secret leaders.

programme.title: Transformers: The Last Knight
programme.desc: Optimus Prime seeks his creator in space. Meanwhile, humans and Autobots join forces to save Earth from an ancient threat.

programme.title: Furiosa: A Mad Max Saga
programme.desc: Stuck in the middle of the conflict between Dementus and Immortan Joe, Furiosa fights to escape from their clutches and return to her safe haven, the Green Place.

programme.title: The Hobbit: The Battle of the Five Armies
programme.desc: Bilbo Baggins, a hobbit, and the dwarves retrieve Lonely Mountain and its treasure. However, a fight breaks out between the dwarves, elves and men over it while Azog and his Orc army prepare for war.

programme.title: Stuart Little
programme.desc: Upon getting adopted by the Littles, Stuart, a mouse, is unwelcomed by his new brother George. So, when Stuart begins to feel low the family helps him find his real parents.

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
programme.desc: John, son of Sarah Connor, sends a reprogrammed Terminator to protect his younger self, who also holds the key to humanity's survival, from the T-1000, an advanced robot created by Skynet.
